scope: Phase 5 hardening backend (harden-phase5-api): isolated e2e stack tooling and coverage tests

findings.title: Seed adopts any mission at topic+position 1 without checking or fixing its taskIds, so re-runs can fail or report tasks the mission doesn't contain
findings.resolution: seed() compares the found mission's taskIds with the seed's and refuses a different mission ('not a seeded state; run down and up') instead of adopting it; it returns mission.taskIds. Test: E2eStackToolTest 'the seed refuses to adopt a mission at its position that holds other tasks'.

findings.title: Seed tooling (blankPdf, idempotent matching, AdminClient) has no automated test
findings.resolution: tools/test/e2e-seed-harness.mjs runs seed() against an in-memory fake admin API; E2eStackToolTest covers seed twice, a foreign mission and blankPdf(2) loaded with PDFBox (2 pages).

findings.title: composeEnv stripping is untested; the dry-run test only proves the -p argument
findings.resolution: --dry-run prints leakedEnv; E2eStackToolTest 'secrets and compose selectors from the caller's environment never reach compose, whatever their case' sets ADMIN_PASSWORD, DOUCKO_DB_PASSWORD, mixed-case child name and compose_file, COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME, DOUCKO_BIND_ADDRESS and asserts none leak.

findings.title: New TaskRules test repeats an existing page-range assertion
findings.resolution: Duplicate page-range assertion removed from TaskRulesTest.

findings.title: Design promises a qa-lock around up..seed..down that is not implemented; concurrent seeds create duplicates
findings.resolution: design.md no longer claims the tool locks: the caller holds scratch/qa-lock for its whole up..down window (the tool would deadlock on it); recorded as an accepted risk; the seed refuses duplicate state, down+up recovers.

findings.title: Env-stripping guard (composeEnv) is not covered by any test; the 'environment names doucko' test only checks the static argv
findings.resolution: Same fix as F03.

findings.title: tasks.md marks review-gate and archive as done before this review and without evidence
findings.resolution: tasks.md: items without an artifact were unticked in d3081de and are ticked only with evidence at archive time.

findings.title: Coverage summary: 2 scenarios — 1 implemented, 1 partial, 0 missing, 0 contradicted
findings.resolution: Summary finding; the open seed scenario is closed by F01/F02/F11.

findings.title: Most tasks are ticked but their artifacts don't exist (4.4 current-state, 4.3 review-findings.json, 4.5 archive, 4.1/2.2 evidence)
findings.resolution: Same as F07: unticked until each artifact existed (review-findings.json, qa report, current-state, archive).

findings.title: Task 2.2 coverage ratchet `--update` is ticked but the baseline didn't change, and nothing shows coverage is restored
findings.resolution: Baseline ratcheted with --update after the final qa:verify (statements 97.76 -> 97.86+, branches 90.94 -> 91.14+), committed in quality/coverage-baseline.json with the archive commit.

findings.title: Seed idempotency scenario has no automated test and no committed proof (task 1.5 ticked without evidence)
findings.resolution: Same as F02; committed proof of the real-stack run in docs/qa/evidence/phase5-e2e-stack.md.

findings.title: The mission is matched by topic+position only, so a foreign mission at position 1 counts as the seed mission
findings.resolution: Same as F01; design.md decision 4 states the rule.

findings.title: Design promises a qa-lock for concurrent up..down/seed, but nothing implements it (concurrent seeds would duplicate)
findings.resolution: Same as F05.

findings.title: Case-variant environment variables survive composeEnv on Windows
findings.resolution: composeEnv deletes blocked keys case-insensitively (and DOUCKO_FRONTEND_DIR is read case-insensitively).

findings.title: The dry-run scenario never checks the child environment, so the env scrubbing (and the never-.env rule) is untested
findings.resolution: Same as F03.

findings.title: The NFR-2 port check accepts any private LAN address, not only 127.0.0.1:18082
findings.resolution: portProblems() requires the frontend to publish exactly 127.0.0.1:18082 and nothing else to be published.

findings.title: The frontendDir test fails when the developer's own DOUCKO_FRONTEND_DIR is set; tests also carry NFR-3 traces that don't fit
findings.resolution: The test removes DOUCKO_FRONTEND_DIR and COMPOSE_* from the child environment; project-guard tests retraced to NFR-10 (data volume), seed tests to NFR-4, env file to NFR-3.

findings.title: Scope drift: `ps` command and DOUCKO_FRONTEND_DIR are not in the spec requirement
findings.resolution: Spec delta now lists ps, DOUCKO_FRONTEND_DIR and the refusal of non-seeded state.

findings.title: The generated blank PDF pages have no /Resources entry
findings.resolution: Pages node carries /Resources << >>; PDFBox loads the generated file with 2 pages.

findings.title: Design names a scratch/qa-lock mutex for up..down that does not exist
findings.resolution: Same as F05.

findings.title: Seed treats any mission at topic+position 1 as the seed mission and never checks its task list
findings.resolution: Same as F01; tasks found in another state than PUBLISHED are published, duplicates refused.

dispositionNote: Run stopped at the --max-total-usd 10 cap ($10.11; 13 verify steps skipped, their findings kept as confirmed/contested). All 21 findings fixed in d3081de; 3 rejected by the verifiers.
